facts.text: Under Beacon Pledge, eligible Massachusetts residents with adjusted gross income of $75,000 or less can attend UMass Boston for $0 in tuition and mandatory fees.

sources.title: Beacon Pledge - UMass Boston
sources.quote: If you're a Massachusetts resident with an adjusted gross income of $75,000 or less, you may qualify to attend UMass Boston for $0 in tuition and mandatory fees.
